name: oil-find
title: Oil Find
description: Search files with Oil Find from Raycast, using its index, filters and search syntax.
author: edgardmello

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files with Oil Find
commands.subtitle: Oil Find
commands.description: Search files and folders in the Oil Find index. Supports Oil Find syntax such as *.pdf, in:~/Documents, dm:week and size:>10mb, plus the filters from your Oil Find library.

commands.name: stash
commands.title: Oil Find Stash
commands.subtitle: Oil Find
commands.description: See the files kept in the Oil Find stash, copy them all at once, open them or remove them.

commands.name: index-status
commands.title: Oil Find Index Status
commands.subtitle: Oil Find
commands.description: See what Oil Find has indexed on each volume and which folders it cannot read.

preferences.name: applicationPath
preferences.title: Oil Find App Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to Oil Find.app or a development build. Leave blank to use the app in Applications.

preferences.name: searchContents
preferences.title: Contents
preferences.label: Also search inside files
preferences.description: Shows matches from Oil Find's content index under the filename results. Follows the content search settings in Oil Find.

preferences.name: showDetail
preferences.title: Details
preferences.label: Show the preview panel by default

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Used by Open Folder in Terminal. Defaults to Terminal.

preferences.name: editorApp
preferences.title: Editor
preferences.description: Adds an Open in Editor action when set.

tools.name: search-files
tools.title: Search Files
tools.description: Search files and folders on this Mac with the Oil Find index, by name, path, kind, date, size or contents. Returns paths with kind, size and modification date.

ai.instructions: Use Oil Find's query syntax instead of natural language in the query: for example `*.pdf contrato dm:lastweek` or `kind:image in:~/Pictures dm:month`. Prefer several narrow searches over one broad one. Mention file paths with ~ for the home folder.

evals.input: @oil-find find the PDFs I changed last week
